question: Does closing pick v2 (a19-closing-pick-synergy-v1, on top of profile v33) gain points on the human setups where it changes the level-4 pick, without costing the default AI where it fires against the AI?
decisionRule: Closing pick v2 in the draft, registered confirmation CPC. Written before any game of this confirmation ran,
November 24, 2026 (UTC).
Origin: the owner: "We need a stronger AI that is able to catch and close picks" (asked what they meant: draft counters)
and "Draft is super important. Especially last lvl4 pick".
Development (no gates): the level-4 battery measured every level-4 creature the AI seat was offered in 59 human games
(battery 10: the 10 recent owner games x 16 seeds; battery56: 49 more human games x 8 seeds), the human seat replaying
its real setup. Closing pick v2 on top of profile v33 changes v33's level-4 pick in 6 of the 59 games: +2.33 points per
game (95% -0.11 to +5.93), 4 better, 0 worse, 2 ties at 100. It was written before battery56 existed; on those 49
held-out games +1.79 (-0.26 to +5.61), 2 better, 2 ties, 0 worse. The other level-4 rules tried on the same games failed
the held-out half (Thunderbird first, a creature prior, legal-feature models). Before this registration, an unregistered
AI-vs-AI development screen (draft-guard mirror, plan seed 2: 2,000 families, 195 changed cases) measured +2.3 points per
changed case (95% -6.2 to +10.8; 37 better, 32 worse; quality 0), and a 40-family smoke (seed 1) had 7 changed cases (0
better, 3 worse). The rule was not changed after either; seeds 1 and 2 are not used below.
Rule (a19-closing-pick-synergy-v1, "closing pick v2"): at the seat's level-4 pick (its last creature pick), when the
counter-draft gate is shut (a19CounterDraftGateOpen false) but the seat sees at least one opposing creature, every
creature on offer is scored with the production matchup model (a19CounterDraftScore, the counter draft's model fitted on
40,040 production games) plus a synergy bonus (+0.04 when the creature would be its faction's second distinct creature in
the army; as the fourth: Life +0.045, Might +0.0175, Nature +0.0075, Chaos +0.005). The best replaces the live decider's
choice when it scores at least 0.05 above that choice (bonus included); otherwise the live choice stands. v33's Queen
counter keeps priority: with the opposing Arachna Queen visible and Magic Dragon offered, Magic Dragon. Research hook
closepick/cp2.ts, ported as src/simulation/ai_iteration/closing_pick.ts with the draft_guard.ts arm cp2_qv (parity with
the original at 2,807 picks, 0 mismatches).
Part A, primary, human setups: the 6 human games where the rule changes v33's level-4 pick: 1a785955 (Angel -> Magic
Dragon) and 9208870e (Champion -> Arachna Queen), recent owner games (battery 10); 76f5f3d5 (Angel -> Thunderbird),
909e7898 (Angel -> Arachna Queen), 3fd7b865 (Champion -> Thunderbird) and 974d9737 (Angel -> Thunderbird), held out
(battery56). Control: the battery's production army (v33's level 4 equals v32's in these games); candidate: the same army
with the rule's level-4 creature; nothing else differs. 64 fresh seeds per game (namespace
closing-pick-confirmation-cpc-20261124-v1), both arms on the same seeds. The human seat replays its real setup
(life-run15 replay seat, real game ids); both seats fight with the v33 bot-seat driver with deep fit (server 565bc0e,
common 9b80f76e; offline, deterministic turn budgets). Estimate: the mean of the 6 games' differences (candidate minus
control, AI score: win 1, draw 0.5), each game weighted equally; 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of seeds
within each game (paired by seed, random.Random(2611245501)), the 6 games fixed.
Part B, AI vs AI (draft_guard.ts, ai:iterate, same tree): the draft-guard mirror families of plan seed 2611245501, 3,000
families (6,000 cases, the candidate on each side), screened by drafting only (cpc_partb_prescreen.ts, no game
fought): every case whose drafted game differs between the live decider and cp2_qv is kept and fought in both arms:
339 cases in 339 families (activation 5.65% of cases). Plan sha256 c0a8a13ff19449e18f2ae4428ca55a271a3afb5fc2c3c0673a4aa575ff460b84. Paired by case; estimate
= the mean over kept families of the family's mean difference; 95% interval from the family bootstrap (plan seed,
10,000 samples). Reported with it: the population estimate (activation x estimate).
Gates, all required:
CPC1 part A: the estimate is above 0 and its 95% lower bound is above 0.
CPC2 part B (changed cases): the estimate is at least -5 points.
CPC3 no more games with a quality error in the candidate arm than in the control arm, in either part.
If every gate passes, the rule is adopted in the default draft decider as A19 profile v34, under the owner's standing
instruction ("always lock in wins and continue"). A gain is claimed for the human setups where the rule changes the
level-4 pick. Not claimed: a win rate against people (the human seat's fight moves are played by the AI), or strength
where the rule does not fire. A failed gate stays recorded as failed: it is not waived, re-run or relabelled.
